data.songTitle: Imogen Heap - The Happy Song - Official Music Video
data.plainLyric:
Bring! Bring! On the bicycle
Beep! Beep! In the car
Ping! Ping! A submarine
Phew! Phew! Helicopter
A choo-choo train
An aeroplane
A "Wee!" down the slide

I just adore-dore-dore
You every day more
Wherever we are

So up in the sky
And deep in the ocean
Through valleys and hills
Away we go

Bring! Bring! On the bicycle
Beep! Beep! In the car
Ping! Ping! A submarine
Phew! Phew! Helicopter
A choo-choo train
An aeroplane
A rocket to the stars!

There's a dance-dance-dance
Going on in my heart
Wherever we are

So up in the sky
And deep in the ocean
Through valleys and hills
Away we go

You little monkey
You're staying up late
Who purrs like a cat
When they get their own way
Who then turns into a lion
Who lets out a...
(Roar)

I love-love-love
You every day more
Whatever's in store

Ooh up in the sky
And deep in the ocean
Through valleys and hills
Away we go

Up in the sky
And deep in the ocean
Through valleys and hills
Away we go
